name: op_dom_id_envelope
description: The `dom_id` envelope field addresses a DOM by id for EVERY node-addressing op, defaulting to the root DOM (0). Before it, every op hardcoded DOM 0, so a VirtualView's document and a <transient-window>'s popup content were unreachable by selector and the only way in was guessing pixel coordinates. This scenario mounts a single DOM, so it pins the three properties that hold app-independently: omitted == 0, an explicit 0 is the same thing, and a DOM that does not exist resolves to NOTHING. The last one is the real gate — if `dom_id` is ignored and ROOT_DOM_ID is hardcoded again, the bogus-DOM assertions below start matching the root DOM and go red.

css: html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
